sentences.en: Tea, drunk from a new thermos, tastes a little metallic.
sentences.zh: 从新保温瓶里喝的茶会带有一点金属味。

sentences.en: Layla could smell that metallic iron smell of blood.
sentences.zh: 莱拉能闻到血液那股铁质的金属气味。

sentences.en: He laughed with a metallic and discordant sound.
sentences.zh: 他发出了一种刺耳的、像金属碰撞般的笑声。

senses.zh: 金属制的；含金属的；(颜色等) 有金属光泽的
